statements.quote: CoreWeave has leased 526 MW of critical IT capacity for a period of 15 years, generating anticipated average annual revenue of over $1B for the combined three phases.
statements.notes: 'Over $1B' is a lower bound, recorded as $1B for both low and high. The figure is anticipated average annual lease revenue from AI/HPC data center capacity over the 15-year term once fully operational, not guidance for a specific fiscal year, so fiscal_year is null. The default outlook-year mapping (filing year + 1) may not fit this figure.
